content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Option 1: NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers. This combo leverages the power of blockchain-based payments, enabling creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies directly on their website. Cloudflare Workers, on the other hand, provide a scalable and secure backend for processing and managing orders. Option 2: Supabase and Cloudflare Pages. This pair offers a robust and flexible solution for storing customer data and managing digital product delivery. Supabase's real-time capabilities ensure seamless order processing, while Cloudflare Pages provide a secure and high-performance hosting environment. Option 3: Google Apps Script and GitHub Pages. This classic combo offers a cost-effective solution for creating and deploying digital product stores. Google Apps Script handles order processing and data storage, while GitHub Pages provide a reliable and free hosting option.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The P2P exchange ecosystem in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and Pakistan has matured significantly alongside crypto adoption. Binance P2P supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees with competitive rates and reasonable liquidity. Local platforms like Patricia and Quidax in Nigeria, and mobile money integrations in Kenya, provide additional conversion routes. Transactions typically complete within 20 to 30 minutes. Conversion fees consistently run 2 to 5 percent — significantly less than what PayPal charges on international transfers. The practical outcome: a buyer in London pays in USDT, the payment confirms on-chain in under 60 seconds, the product delivers automatically, and the creator converts to local currency within 30 minutes.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments enables fast and secure transactions, with USDT on Tron settling in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This not only reduces transaction costs but also minimizes the time it takes for buyers to receive their digital products. In contrast, traditional payment platforms often charge higher fees and have longer processing times, negatively impacting the overall experience for creators and buyers alike.
Creators in Pakistan can now sell digital downloads to international buyers without relying on Stripe.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, creators maintain full ownership of their digital products and customer data, ensuring complete control over their business. Automation is also a key feature, with orders processed and delivered seamlessly to customers. In contrast, traditional payment platforms often require creators to surrender ownership and control to the platform, limiting their ability to customize and manage their business.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
